facts.fact: Guinea's Minister of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy Rose Pola Pricemou signed with Sierra Leone's minister on 22 November 2024 a framework agreement covering infrastructure sharing, cybercrime and free roaming.
facts.system: Sierra Leone-Guinea framework agreement on telecommunications and digital economy
